answer: An identity requires a bonded escrow of 500 units held against a hardware key tied to one physical device, and a registered lantern credential signs each agent's message stream. A detected sybil loses 100 percent of the bond and waits 30 epochs before re-registration, and any plume submitted as work proof is voided. Copying or splitting identities does not help, because the marginal cost is 500 units per fake identity plus a shared saffron penalty paid by every linked key.
